name: nimbus
description: Nimbus — a real-time collaborative cloud IDE with per-user runtimes

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix runtime install && npm --prefix orchestrator install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,orch,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix orchestrator run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix runtime run typecheck && npm --prefix orchestrator run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix runtime run build && npm --prefix orchestrator run build && npm --prefix web run build
